title: Adjunctive digital adherence support versus standard of care in adults initiating oral therapy

endpoints.name: Proportion adherent at week 12
endpoints.measure: Proportion of participants with pill-count adherence of 80% or greater

endpoints.name: Change in symptom score
endpoints.measure: Change from baseline in validated 24-item symptom scale

inclusion: Confirmed diagnosis within the last 12 months
Owns a smartphone capable of running the study application
Able to provide written informed consent
exclusion: Participation in another interventional study within 30 days
Known contraindication to the index therapy
Cognitive impairment preventing use of the study application
Not able to provide written informed consent

statistics.missing_data_strategy: Multiple imputation under missing-at-random, with tipping-point sensitivity analysis
